headline: Brazil's B3 to Extend Trading Hours Starting Nov. 3 as US Clocks Change
summary: B3 will expand operating hours for its exchange and OTC equities and derivatives markets beginning Tuesday, Nov. 3, aligning with the end of daylight saving time in the United States.
why: B3 operates Brazil's only securities and commodities exchange. Modifying trading hours maintains alignment with North American trading sessions and foreign investor flows.

impacts.name: B3 SA
impacts.why: Extended operating hours adapt market infrastructure to international session shifts, impacting daily trading schedules.
